errors.message: MCP error -32603: Server "dictionary-lexicon-mcp" is misconfigured: its endpoint points back at the MCPize gateway (dictionary-lexicon-mcp.mcpize.run), which would loop instead of reaching a real server. If you own this server, set its endpoint to your actual upstream URL under Dashboard → Servers → dictionary-lexicon-mcp → Settings, or redeploy it so MCPize provisions hosting for you.
